name: thinklight
description: macOS only. Turns the Mac's camera LED into an AI busy light: on while the agent works, off when it's your turn. To light that LED it opens the built-in camera (plus a Studio Display camera when docked) and discards every frame in the callback — no image processing, no recording, no disk writes. Its hooks fire on every turn to write a local session token naming the session id and owning pid; no prompt or response content is read, and nothing leaves the machine. Optional sound stays off until you run /thinklight:unmute. Requires the thinklight programs in ~/.local/bin, installed separately by get.sh or install.sh from the repository.
